column1: Rules that apply to every release.

column2: A release goes ahead on its date. A squad that is not ready does not hold it; its flags stay off
Work enters a release when it passes SIT. Work that misses SIT moves to the next release behind its flag
The design of the next epic is signed while the current epic is built (DT05)
Epics 3 to 8 are confirmed one month ahead, at the sponsor review before their design sign-off
A role receives real users at the release that gives it a screen; until then it has test users in SIT and UAT (DL39)
Every release has a rollback: flags off first, then the previous tag
A release that reads a new ACE table or column waits for RWB-ACE-001; the ACE batch for the business date is the data date of the release
